name: Icatia
description: The human nation of Sarpadia, destroyed by orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids.

description_citations.text: "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Following the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally break their ties with the rest of Icatia.
timeline.quote: After the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally broke their ties with the rest of Icatia.

citation.text: Farrel's Zealot (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Icatian army repels early Orc surprise attacks on border towns like Montford.
timeline.quote: The Icatian army easily repelled early surprise attacks by the Orcs on border towns like Montford.

citation.text: Icatian Infantry (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Icatian Phalanxes keep fighting after the wall is breached in half a dozen places.
timeline.quote: Even after the wall was breached in half a dozen places, the Phalanxes fought on

citation.text: Icatian Phalanx (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Icatia falls, the last of the Sarpadian empires.
timeline.quote: Valiant Icatia was the last of the Sarpadian empires to fall.

citation.text: Icatian Infantry (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Icatia's towns become armed camps by the time the empire falls.
timeline.quote: By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

citation.text: Icatian Town (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ailis Connaut writes in her diary that Icatia could not be saved but children were given time.
timeline.quote: "In these, our final days, I offer this. Though we could not save Icatia, we gave our children time to grow, and love, before it fell."

citation.text: Icatian Scout (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tamun and Reod are forced to kill an Icatian patrol, and Reod's past as the Icatian soldier Robin Davis is revealed.
timeline.quote: Reod was an Icatian soldier, born Robin Davis

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "To Havenwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
timeline.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Ailis Connaut acted with honor and bravery in the defense of the town of Montford

citation.text: Icatian Scout (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A Sarpadian empire whose soldiers defended their cities to the end; the last Sarpadian empire to fall.

citation.text: Fallen Empires: card flavor text (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: An empire whose towns became armed camps as the climate cooled.
